step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows automated sensitive data discovery using Amazon Macie across multiple AWS accounts. Findings are centralized into an S3 bucket in a primary AWS Account. Amazon Athena queries the findings, Amazon QuickSight visualizes the risk metrics, and MySQL/AWS Glue handle data lake storage and aggregation.

graph.name: Opportune Sensitive Data Discovery with Amazon Macie
graph.notes: Architecture uses Amazon Macie across multiple accounts to aggregate metadata findings into a central S3 bucket analyzed by Athena and QuickSight.
